method: Identical local font bytes and raw KaTeX CSS, BUS-01 / A4, one persistent isolated Node process per revision, explicit GC before/after each sample outside timings. Two warmups per task and alternating AB/BA. Times exclude harness and DOM oracle. Preview covers snapshot, analysis, render, integrity, screen composition only. Browser layout/startup, typing debounce, actual downloads, OS print and PDF are excluded. Heap is process-level V8 retained heap after repeated actions and forced GC, not browser memory or a peak. Percentile is nearest-rank; with five heavy pairs p95 equals max.
